messages:
Sara Li: Hey everyone, ACME Payments opened a support ticket: after their IdP rotated signing certs they started seeing intermittent 503s on the ACS endpoint. Customer reports issue began ~30m post-rotation.

Jordan K: Can you attach a redacted SAML POST (just Recipient/Audience/Signature) so we can check the assertion Recipient vs configured ACS?

Sara Li: Dropping redacted assertion below (removed PII):

```xml
<samlp:Response>
  <saml:Assertion>
    <saml:Subject>
      <saml:SubjectConfirmation>
        <saml:SubjectConfirmationData Recipient="https://app.acme-payments.com/sso/acs" />
      </saml:SubjectConfirmation>
    </saml:Subject>
    <ds:Signature>...base64...</ds:Signature>
  </saml:Assertion>
</samlp:Response>
```

Sara Li: Their logs show POST -> 503 intermittently. Our edge logs show some requests hitting a different route and returning 200.

Matt R: Do we have the IdP metadata URL and the ACS the IdP advertises? Suspect ACS mismatch (trailing slash variant) or split routing.

Sara Li: IdP metadata: https://idp.acme-payments.com/metadata.xml. Metadata lists ACS as https://app.acme-payments.com/sso/acs (no trailing slash). The onboarding page in our console shows the tenant entered ACS as https://app.acme-payments.com/sso/acs/ (with trailing slash).

Keisha N: That can produce two canonical routes at the edge. We've seen pools behind different route rules with different cached metadata/cert state.

Jordan K: Grep edge for both paths for that tenant. Need to know which origin pool handled each path and cert thumbprint.

Sara Li: Log excerpt (redacted):

```nedge-a 2025-09-03T09:12:05 POST /sso/acs -> route=acs-v2 pool=origin-pool-1 status=200 tenant=acct-ACME
edge-b 2025-09-03T09:12:12 POST /sso/acs/ -> route=legacy-redirect pool=origin-pool-2 status=503 tenant=acct-ACME
```

idp-watcher-bot: metadata-fetch idp.acme-payments.com status=200 fetched_at=2025-09-03T08:42:01 cert-thumb=sha256:aa11bb... expires=2026-04-30

Matt R: Looks like two distinct routing rules. One pool is serving the new cert/metadata; the other hasn't applied the rotated IdP cert yet or is using a stale metadata blob.

Jordan K: Repro steps for eng/sre to validate: 
1) POST same SAML assertion to both /sso/acs and /sso/acs/ (keep body identical).
2) Capture TLS cert served by each origin pool: `openssl s_client -connect origin:443 -servername app.acme-payments.com` (compare cert thumbprints).
3) Inspect our metadata watcher logs to see which pool applied the new metadata and when.

Keisha N: Mitigation: purge edge cache for both paths for this tenant and force metadata revalidation for idp.acme-payments.com. Also add a temporary edge redirect to canonicalize trailing slash.

Sara Li: I told customer to pause retries while we perform the purge and revalidate. They're ok with a short maintenance window.

Matt R: Running commands now:

``
edgectl purge --tenant acct-ACME --path "/sso/acs"
edgectl purge --tenant acct-ACME --path "/sso/acs/"
# force immediate metadata refresh
idpctl revalidate --entity idp.acme-payments.com --force
```

idp-watcher-bot: revalidate job started for idp.acme-payments.com triggered_by=Matt R

Matt R: After purge + revalidate, watch for edge logs to converge to the same route/pool and cert thumbstring. If 503 persists, enable SAML debug on auth service: `SAML_V=debug` to capture signature validation errors.

Jordan K: If debug shows signature verification failures on one pool, that indicates our internal mapping may contain duplicate IdP entries (one mapping for ACS w/ slash, one w/o). We'll need to dedupe mapping and ensure cert selection picks the newest thumbprint.

Keisha N: Action items:
- Matt R: purge + revalidate (in progress)
- Jordan K: run SAML signature debug if errors continue
- Sara Li: coordinate customer maintenance window and test confirmation

Sara Li: Update: purge + revalidate completed. idp-watcher-bot reports new thumb sha256:cc22dd... applied across pools. Asked customer to retry.

Sara Li: Customer retried and reports no more 503s. First 30m stable, will monitor and close if stable for 1h.

Jordan K: Postmortem notes: we should normalize ACS path during onboarding (strip trailing slash) and add an invariant to metadata mapping to avoid split routing. Also add a metric to detect per-tenant IdP cert thumb divergence across routing pools during rotation.

Sara Li: Thanks all, closing thread once customer confirms 60m stability. :thumbsup:
